content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Anonymous Checkout ## slug: anonymous-checkout ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End You can check out {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s without defining any of their information (name, email address, etc.) using our guest checkout process! **Example Use Case** I am a student registering for a campus {{variable.Object_Event}}, the Event Organizer doesn't require {{variable.Object_Attendee}} information, but simply needs an idea of how many {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will show up to the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ## Setup 1. Create an {{variable.Object_Event}}. 2. Create a new {{variable.Object_EventItem}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = {{variable.Picklist_ETEventItem_Mainevent}}. 4. Mark all Attendee Form fields as "Hide". 5. Done! ![D_6_10_setup](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_6_10_setup.png){height="" width=""} ## Anonymous Checkout 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} page. 2. Select the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s to purchase. An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} may register for an {{variable.Object_Event}} with paid {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, free {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, or when the Pay Later option is available. ![D_6_10_checkout 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_6_10_checkout%201.png){height="" width=""} {{snippet.EventItem_Checkout10orLess}} ![D_6_10_checkout 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/D_6_10_checkout%202.png){height="" width=""} 3. Once an Attendee completes registration, an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record will be made in Salesforce. This record will have no contact information for the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}.
